candidate.definition_en: To deliberately make someone angry, or to stimulate or give rise to a particular reaction or emotion.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تستفز شخص وتخليه يتعصب، أو تثير وتسبب رد فعل معين (زي إثارة نقاش أو غضب).

senses.definition_en: To deliberately make someone annoyed or angry.
examples: He tried to provoke me into a fight.

senses.definition_en: To stimulate or cause a particular reaction, feeling, or discussion.
senses.definition_ar: يثير أو يسبب رد فعل أو نقاشاً.
examples: The article was written to provoke discussion.
He tried to provoke me into a fight.
The article was written to provoke discussion.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Provoke' قريبة من 'Volcano' 'بركان'.. لما تعمل 'Provoke' لحد بتخليه ينفجر زي البركان.
